## Why This Is Asked
This question probes building robust on-device data pipelines, balancing persistence, background work, and server-side idempotency under connectivity churn.

## Key Concepts
- Offline persistence: durable on-disk queue (CoreData/SQLite)
- Batch uploads: URLSession background transfers and queue flushing
- Idempotent server API: dedup by event ID; safe retries
- Testing: simulate disconnects, restarts, partial failures

## Code Example
```swift
struct AnalyticsEvent: Codable {
  let id: String
  let name: String
  let timestamp: Date
  let payload: [String: String]
}
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you guarantee at-least-once delivery while avoiding duplicates on the server?
- How would you test resilience to app termination mid-upload?
